item.text:
**Confirmed change:** Beginning next month, the library’s storytelling hour will move to Saturdays. The weekday book exchange will continue as usual, with no changes to its current schedule.

**Proposal under consideration:** The library is exploring the possibility of adding a craft session after the Saturday storytelling hour. This has not been confirmed and will depend on whether enough volunteers are available to help lead and support the activity.
